editorial_workflow.subtitle: A small structure for traceable research notes
editorial_workflow.message: Make the boundary between evidence and interpretation visible.
editorial_workflow.description: Give every quotation or paraphrase a source and a precise locator. Put your interpretation in a separate, clearly labeled field, preserve the source’s limits, and record what still needs checking. When your conclusion changes, retain a brief correction trail so you can see which source supported which version.
